english:
Landing 5 damaging hits while an elemental buff is active spawns an Orb of Power at your location that grants 0.5% Super Energy. Hits count at most once every 0.8 seconds, requiring at least 4 seconds to spawn an Orb. Damage against immune enemies also counts.

1 second cooldown after Orb spawns before further hits are counted.

Qualifying effects:
• <arc Amplified /> or <arc Bolt Charge />
• <solar Cure />, <solar Radiant />, or <solar Restoration />
• <void Devour />, <void Invisibility />, or <void Overshield />
• <stasis Frost Armor />
• <strand Woven Mail />
• Standing in a Healing Rift, for no reason

source.text:
4 Piece | Collective Power

Upon scoring 5 damage instances while any Elemental Buff is active:
Spawns an Orb of Power on the user that grants 0.5% Super Energy.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orb where additional damage instances will not count.
Only counts a hit up to once every 0.8s, meaning the perk takes AT LEAST 4 seconds to trigger. 
Consecutive triggers take a minimum of 5 seconds to reproc.

Damage Instances dealt to Immune Enemies count towards spawning Orbs.

Elemental Buffs:
Amplified, Bolt Charge | Cure, Radiant, Restoration | Devour, Invisibility, Overshield
Frost Armor | Woven Mail
And also standing in a Healing Rift for no reason
